role: Async circuit breaker protecting callable functions from cascading failures via state machine.
detail: Implements a generic circuit breaker with three states (CLOSED, OPEN, HALF_OPEN) protecting any async callable. CLOSED allows normal calls; OPEN rejects immediately and sleeps; HALF_OPEN admits exactly one probe. Key classes: CircuitBreaker (main state machine, guards state with asyncio.Lock and probe semaphore), CircuitBreakerState (enum of three states), CircuitBreakerOpenError (raised on open circuit, carries retry_after_seconds). Failure threshold configurable (default 3), cooldown configurable (default 30s). Uses time.monotonic() to track open-time and elapsed duration. Probe serialization via asyncio.Semaphore(1) ensures only one concurrent recovery attempt. On failure in CLOSED, increments counter and opens if threshold reached; on success resets counter. Probe success closes; probe failure reopens. reset() method clears state but is not lock-safe during concurrent calls.
gotchas: reset() is not coroutine-safe if called during concurrent call() execution; only safe in tests or maintenance contexts. Direct access to _probe_semaphore._value (line 203) bypasses public API. retry_after_seconds is floored to 0.0 if already elapsed.
